briefdescription.para: Unified incident emitter for training module incident classes (Phase 3).

detaileddescription.para:
Provides a listener-pattern emitter that unifies diagnostic incident reporting across the three training incident classes:
Dataset (labeling, enrichment, data validation)
Training (step execution, convergence, checkpoint)
Adapter (merge, serving, handoff)

All three classes emit TrainingIncident events to registered TrainingIncidentListener implementations. The emitter is thread-safe: listener registration and broadcast are protected by an internal mutex.
